text: The plane was repaired, and flew for almost twenty-five more years. Pearson and Quintal were later given an award for outstanding airmanship. Everyone called it the Gimli Glider. When it finally retired, pieces of it were turned into luggage tags. One wrong number nearly brought it down. A dropped propeller, a glider pilot's trick, and an old runway brought it home. What would you have done at forty-one thousand feet? Tell me in the comments.
